pages.text: Wargs are great war hounds created from experienced Black Wolves. They are stronger, tougher, resistant to knockback, able to leap over obstacles, and unharmed by short falls. Like their smaller kin, they remain loyal to their master and can be healed with meat.

To create one, keep at least four owned wolves within eight blocks of a $(l:goety:crafts/artifice/howling_totem)Howling Totem$(). Bind a Waystone to the Totem and use it on an eligible Black Wolf. The wolf becomes a Warg of the corresponding breed. Skeleton Wolves and Hellhounds cannot be promoted.

Each Totem can create only one Warg, and a master may normally command no more than three. Breaking the Totem does not free its Warg slot while that Warg lives. A Warg remains bound to its original Totem and can benefit from its protection.

An owned Warg accepts a Saddle and can be ridden, with charged jumps carrying both hound and rider over great distances. It can also hold any sword in its mouth, replacing its bite with a sweeping spin and a lunging vertical slash. Use an empty hand to retrieve the sword.

Wargs use their own larger armor harnesses. The recipes for these, together with armor for other canine servants, are recorded in the $(l:goety:crafts/artifice/howling_totem#canine_armor)Howling Totem entry$().
